title: ThreadForge — Storage / MinIO Health
description: OPERATIONAL_CONTRACT: What is the latency of MinIO operations as measured by synthetic Blackbox exporter probes? | METRICS_DEPENDENCY: [probe_duration_seconds_bucket{target=~'.*minio.*'}] | METRICS_SOURCE: Blackbox exporter probe module 'minio_mtls' via ServiceMonitor | BREAKS_IF: Blackbox exporter pod deleted OR probe module removed OR MinIO unreachable | OWNER: Storage / Observability SRE | Last validated: 2026-02-09
notes: Panels render only where underlying metrics are present. Empty panels indicate intentionally uninstrumented components.

panels.title: Policy Decision: Storage Latency
panels.description: PANEL_CONTRACT: Question: Is storage latency acceptable to accept new work? | METRIC: policy_decision{policy="storage_latency"} | DENY: Do not accept new work (manual review required)

panels.title: Policy Reason: Storage Latency
panels.description: PANEL_CONTRACT: What caused the storage_latency policy decision? | METRIC: policy_reason_code{policy="storage_latency"} | CODES: 0=DENY_missing_input,1=DENY_threshold_exceeded,2=ALLOW

panels.title: Pressure: Margin
panels.description: PANEL_CONTRACT: Margin = 0.25 - p95 | METRIC: policy_pressure_margin{policy="storage_latency"} | Negative values indicate breach

panels.title: Unease Count
panels.description: PANEL_CONTRACT: Sum of unease signals (allow_under_pressure, deny_missing_input, volatility_breach) for policy storage_latency
